Subject: Clarion Security request - supply chain & app assurance

Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo yesterday. Procurement asked me to collect a concise package covering your application security posture and software supply-chain practices for our risk committee. Specifically we're after:
- Static and dynamic testing cadence and tooling (SAST/DAST)
- Patch SLA commitments by severity
- Summary of last external penetration test and remediation status
- SBOM generation/process for customer deliveries

Can you provide a single packet and a short summary email for the committee by Dec 18? We need clear remediation SLAs for critical/high findings so we can map to our vendor risk scoring.

Best,
Elizabeth
Elizabeth Gardner
Sr. Procurement Manager
Clarion Health

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Elizabeth Gardner <elizabeth.gardner@clarionhealth.com>
Cc: rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-04T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Clarion Security request - supply chain & app assurance

Elizabeth — thanks for the clear ask. Attaching a compact package and a one-page summary we hope fits the committee format. High level here in the body:

1) Testing and tools:
- Static analysis: daily/CI SAST with rule set tuned to reduce noise; we run SAST (internal runner based on open-source engines + proprietary rules) against all PRs and night builds. Results are triaged by engineering and assigned within 24 hours.
- Dynamic testing: weekly DAST for public endpoints and pre-release DAST for major releases. Agent-based scanning for auth-protected flows via test accounts.
- Third-party dependency scanning: continuous dependency scanning (OSS vulnerability DB) with weekly alerts.

2) Patch SLA commitments (default, negotiable in contract):
- Critical (RCE/active exploit): 48 hours from confirmed reproducible report to mitigation plan + expedited patch delivery; full remediation targeted within 7 days (hotfix or mitigation).
- High: 5 business days for mitigation plan, 15 business days for remediation where feasible.
- Medium: 30 calendar days.
- Low: next scheduled release.

3) Pen test summary:
- Last externally contracted test: Oct 2026, conducted by Sentinel Audit (third-party). Summary attached (pen_test_summary_clarion_2026.pdf) with findings breakdown and CVE mapping. All critical findings were mitigated within 72 hours of validation; high findings are in progress (ETA mid-Dec).

4) SBOM and supply-chain:
- We produce CycloneDX-compatible SBOMs per build and can export per-customer SBOM in CSV or JSON. Attached: redwood_sbom_overview_2026.csv (sample). Our build pipeline records provenance and hashed artifacts for reproducibility.

I've cc'd Rafael (security programs) and Grace (product ops) for any technical follow-ups. If you prefer, we can convert the package into a short deck for the committee.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Solutions - Redwood Inference
(Attachment: redwood_sbom_overview_2026.csv, pen_test_summary_clarion_2026.pdf, sast-dast-results-summary.xlsx)

Vanessa — quick notes to refine the packet before we send to Clarion:

Vanessa / Rafael — thanks. A couple clarifying questions from the committee:
1) For the 48-hour critical SLA, can you confirm whether that includes time-to-detection (i.e., from report receipt vs. from triage confirmation)? We need the clock to be clear for our scoring.
2) Are SBOMs generated for legacy images in your hosted environment or only for new builds? We have some legacy artifacts that must be inventoried.
3) On pen-test remediation: can you provide ticket numbers for the three open high findings and an estimated remediation window per item?

If it's easier to banter over a 30-min call, we can set one up next week.

Regards,
Elizabeth

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Clarion Security request - supply chain & app assurance

Elizabeth — answers inline and attached an updated one-page packet with explicit ticket refs and signed SBOM examples.

1) SLA clock: the 48-hour window begins on confirmation of a reproducible issue (we acknowledge all incoming reports within 4 business hours and perform an initial triage; if we validate the issue as "critical" the SLA clock starts. We will add this definition to the contract appendix.)

2) SBOMs for legacy images: we maintain an inventory and can generate SBOMs for legacy deployed images in the hosted environment upon request. For negotiated enterprise contracts we can include a backfill project (time-and-materials) to produce SBOMs for older artifacts; typical backfill throughput: ~200 images/week depending on complexity.

3) Pen test open high findings: ticket RED-1298 (ETA 2026-12-22), RED-1303 (ETA 2026-12-24), RED-1311 (ETA 2026-12-20). All have assigned owners and a mitigation plan; referenced in attached pen_test_summary_clarion_2026.pdf (appendix). Critical findings from Oct test were closed and have audit evidence.

Next steps: we can host a 30-min review on Tuesday Dec 21 at 10am PT to walk the packet and confirm committee questions. I included a short checklist in the attached summary to expedite sign-off.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Solutions - Redwood Inference
